metadata.title: त्रिपुरा का आदिवासी खाना | Food of Tiprasa | Tribal food of Tripura | Food of Indigenous People
metadata.description: Tripura, located in Northeast India, is a region abundant with diverse indigenous tribal communities. These tribes boast a vibrant food culture and a storied history. To commemorate the birth anniversary of Birsa Munda, a revered tribal leader, Agartala hosts a special food festival. This celebration of tribal heroes is an integral part of the Janjatiya Gaurav Divas, an event organized by the central government to honor indigenous communities across India. The festival in Agartala serves as a platform to showcase the rich culinary heritage and cultural significance of the indigenous tribes in Tripura.
